subject: Beschwerde: Festplatz nach dem Sommerfest

triage.summary: Sender complains that beer crates and garbage bags were left on the festival grounds after the summer festival, where kindergarten children play, and demands better post-event cleanup.
triage.proposed_action: Forward to the board/event organizer as a safety complaint; ensure immediate cleanup of the Festplatz and a human reply with a review of post-event cleanup responsibilities.

details.issue: Bierkästen und Müllsäcke blieben nach dem Sommerfest am Festplatz liegen, auf dem Kindergartenkinder spielen
